aliases: Ice and snow path dao marks

summary.text: Snow path dao marks are law traces of snow path, often named together with ice as ice and snow path dao marks. Dense marks expand cold terrain, stock snow resources, and can host frost ice flame.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan’s first earthly calamity, snow path dao marks are the highest count in his sovereign immortal aperture, above qi path marks taken from Qi Zai and above strength and transformation path marks from that same calamity. Those marks begin to influence the aperture: Mini Northern Plains gains a large and still-expanding snowy plain suited to cold-resistant plants.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.

Fang Yuan undergoes the first earthly calamity in the icy plain and obtains a huge number of ice and snow path dao marks. Because of those marks, Mini Northern Plains has snow falling from the sky, an environment that suits snow monsters.

Desolate plant snow willows have an abundance of snow path dao marks. Ice spike divine apes are ice path, and the two complement each other when Heavenly Lord Bai Zu plants a snow willow field as a foothold.

Frost energy from ice path crystal essence contains the crystal’s ice and snow path dao marks. Those marks carve into the surroundings for a while before dissipating, modify the environment into a habitat suited to snowmen and snow monsters, and do not increase the sovereign immortal aperture’s total of ice and snow path dao marks.

Where ice and snow path dao marks are dense, there is a chance that frost ice flame forms. Most of that flame is filled with ice and snow path dao marks, while the heart of the flame has dense fire path dao marks.
Fang Yuan later restates frost ice flame as a fire path immortal material produced in an area of dense ice and snow path dao marks.
